lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: After casting an ability, Bel'Veth gains 2 stacks for 5 seconds, stacking up to 6 times and refreshing on subsequent ability casts. While Bel'Veth has stacks, she becomes ghosted and gains 25–50% bonus attack speed. Her basic attacks each consume 1 stack.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Whenever Bel'Veth scores a takedown against a champion or monster within 3 seconds of damaging them, she gains stacks of Lavender permanently. Large monsters grant her 1 stack and champions and epic monsters grant her 2. Each stack grants her 0.25–1.25% bonus attack speed.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bel'Veth can exceed the attack speed cap, but all sources of damage dealt or triggered by her basic attacks are reduced by 25%, including on-hit effects. She cannot gain attack speed through growth (per level).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Bel'Veth dash a fixed distance in a designated direction, though not through terrain, dealing 10–30 (+ 110% AD) physical damage to enemies she passes through and applying on-hit and spell effects at 75% effectiveness to the first target hit.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Passive: Bel'Veth's basic attacks on-hit apply a mark to the target for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and expiring upon attacking a new target. Every second attack on-hit against the marked target deals 6–10 (3 ranks) (+ 12% bonus AD) bonus true damage and grants a stack that increases this damage by the same value. This effect stacks infinitely, but is capped at 5 stacks against epic monster.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Additionally, whenever Bel'Veth scores a takedown against a champion or epic monster while being alive, a Void Coral is spawned from their corpse for 15 seconds. and summon an enhanced Void Coral.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Bel'Veth dash to the target Void Coral and consumes it over the cast time, slow nearby enemies by 25%, which ramps up to 99% over the duration, then creates an explosion that deals 150–250 (3 ranks) (+ 100% AP) (+ 25–35 (3 ranks)% of target's missing health) true damage to them. Upon consumption, Bel'Veth also consumes all other existing Void Corals, gains a stack of Death in Lavender|Lavender}} per Void Coral consumed, and assumes her True Form for 60 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If Bel'Veth consumed at least one enhanced Void Coral, she gains an enhanced True Form that lasts 180 seconds and causes Void Remora to spawn from the deaths of nearby lane minions.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Void Remora have 70% of the minion's maximum health and 110% of the minion's AD.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: True Form: Bel'Veth evolves into a monster, gaining 100–200 (3 ranks) (+ 165% bonus AD) (+ 90% AP) bonus health, 25–75 (3 ranks) bonus movement speed out-of-combat, 50–100 (3 ranks) bonus attack range, as well as 10–20 (3 ranks)% increased total attack speed. She also gains the ability to dash through terrain with Void Surge}}. Consuming Void Corals while in this state refreshes the duration of True Form and heal Bel'Veth for 100–200 (3 ranks) (+ 165% bonus AD) (+ 90% AP).
